NATO's purpose is to safeguard the freedom and security of all its members NATO's 5% commitment At the 2025 NATO Summit, Allies made a commitment to investing 5% of GDP annually on defence and security by 2035. Strengthening NATO's eastern flank NATO has massively reinforced its deterrence and defence posture, strengthening its readiness to protect and defend all Allies. Support for Ukraine NATO and Allies are providing Ukraine with unprecedented levels of support, helping to uphold its fundamental right to self-defence. As we’re building a new nato.int some content will be in transition. Thanks for your patience – please keep coming back to see the improvements. News In focus Multimedia highlights What is NATO? NATO is a political and military alliance of countries from Europe and North America. Its members are committed to protecting each other from any threat.
